text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm strolling around the
shopping
district...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Great. What a mess I've gotten myself
into... Let's
see... There's shrimp, mixed
tempura, squid, bell
peppers...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing serious. One of the older

shopkeepers in the shopping district
gave me a
hefty amount of tempura.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And while I'm incredibly happy and
grateful for
his gift, there's simply no
way I can finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Deep-fried foods are so oily and heavy,
and
eating so much in one sitting is
guaranteed to end
in a nasty bout of
indigestion!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Grated daikon radish? How would that
help?
choice_data_list: Pick up the eating pace with grated daikon!
It's a tempura festival at the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... That sounds just like the
kind of
thing a grandmother would say,
and I love golden
nuggets of wisdom
like that.
choice_data_list: Effective for relieving a heavy stomach!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I remember my aunt
teaching
me a good way to use up
leftover tempura a long
time ago.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to buy some daikon radishes
at the
supermarket! I'll be able to eat as
much tempura
as I want with their help!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
At the dorm? Oh, that's a great idea. I
can just
leave it in the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That way, I don't have to go around
telling
everyone about the tempura, and
anyone who
wants some can help
themselves!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It'll be great exposure for the tasty
tempura place
in the shopping district
too. Yup, all's well that
ends well.
